_comment: Seed addresses we walk to in order to discover peers (the Lab 3 server and our teammates). These are NOT registered as IPv8 'formal' bootstrappers (which would blacklist them and hide them from get_peers); instead we walk_to them ourselves so every discovered node - server and teammates alike - is treated uniformly and filtered purely by public key / community. Dead seeds are harmless: they simply never respond. Any working bootstrap server in our community can introduce us to the rest; the professor's server just happens to be the one that is currently alive.
